description.value: Embers Wine & Charcuterie Cellar bills itself as Nanaimo's only wine and charcuterie cellar, offering curated cured meats, artisan cheeses, cured seafood, and an extensive wine list in a cellar-style setting on Front Street. It is part of a family of local restaurants also including The View Oceanside Grill and Top Notch Burgers. The intimate venue is reservations-recommended and is a 19+ establishment.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 93m; stands (3 spaces) at 93m. Total: 5 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and provides strong evidence for this listing. The site confirms the business is a real, open restaurant at 91 Front Street, Nanaimo, BC, with active team bios, menus, and promotions. The FAQ explicitly addresses takeout, dietary options, and accessibility (not wheelchair accessible, steps required), and the contact page confirms no phone line exists. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM tag 'fixme: Re-verify address' present; OSM address field is blank. Website address used (91 Front Street, Nanaimo, BC V9R 5H9).
Minor postal code discrepancy on website: contact page shows V9R 5H4 while all other pages consistently show V9R 5H9. V9R 5H9 used as it appears on the majority of pages.

Website and contact page explicitly state the establishment is not wheelchair accessible: 'No, we do not have a wheelchair access. There are two steps required to get down into the restaurant and then also a few more steps within our seating area.'
19+ establishment; minors are not permitted. Relevant for cyclists traveling with children.
No phone line; contact is email-only (embersnanaimo@outlook.com).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating restaurant in Nanaimo with a live website, current team bios, and promotions. No grounds for exclusion.

Takeout.detail: FAQ states: 'We can arrange for a board to be prepared for take-out with one week advance notice.' A take-out fee and automatic gratuity apply; request via email

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQ confirms: 'We do have many vegetarian options, as well as some vegan options, including a vegan cheddar.' Also: 'many gluten-free crackers and accompaniments available, and our cheeses, meats, and seafood options are all gluten-free' (cross-contamination caveat noted)

wow_evidence: part of a family of local restaurants also including The View Oceanside Grill and Top Notch Burgers
